admin_help:
Admin commands:
/jail @user 30m [quiet|rowdy|vip] reason, /jail 30m @user reason, or reply with /jail 30m reason - put user into the psychiatric center. No duration means manual release.
/rehab [user_id|@username] - release from the psychiatric center.
/mute [user_id|@username] [duration] [reason] - mute in the whole chat.
/unmute [user_id|@username] - remove Telegram mute.
/banforever [user_id|@username] [reason] - ban and store forever ban.
/unbanforever [user_id|@username] - remove forever ban and unban.
/unban [user_id|@username] - alias for /unbanforever.
/all [text] - mention known members.
/status [user_id|@username] - show moderation status.
/profile - show your profile. Reply with /profile to show that user's profile.
/activity [user_id|@username] - show user's message activity.
/topactive [limit] - show most active known users.
/karma [user_id|@username] - show user karma.
/topkarma [limit] - show karma leaderboard.
/shop - show karma shop.
/buy title|charm|quote - spend karma on harmless chat effects.
/ward - show current psychiatric-center ward and rules.
/warn [user_id|@username] [reason] - add a warning.
/warnings [user_id|@username] - list active warnings.
/unwarn [warn_id] - deactivate a warning.
/clearwarns [user_id|@username] - clear active warnings.
/spampardon [user_id] - clear spam strikes and remove bot spam-mute.
/addphoto [tag] [caption] - add a replied photo to the local photo base.
/photo [tag] - reply with a random photo from the base.
/photos [tag] - list photos in the base.
/delphoto [id] - delete a photo from the base.
/addquote [#tag] [text | author] - add a Laya quote. Can be a reply to a message.
/quote [tag] - send a random Laya quote.
/quotes [tag] - list Laya quotes.
/delquote [id] - delete a Laya quote.
/faq [question] - answer a FAQ question.
/job [text] - send a job application to the owner.
/donate [amount/comment] - send a donation request to the owner.
/idea [text] - send an idea to the general director.
/bug [text] - report a bug to the owner.
/appeal [text] - appeal a Laya/moderation decision to the owner.
/addfaq pattern1; pattern2 | answer - add a FAQ answer.
/faqs - list FAQ answers.
/delfaq [id] - delete a FAQ answer.

Durations: 10m, 2h, 3d, 1w, forever.
For /all the bot can mention only members it has already seen in messages or join events.

debug_help:
Debug/setup commands:
/reload - reload config, state, and local bases from disk.
/auth [key] - register yourself as owner and set this private chat for logs.
/myid - show your user ID.
/spamlog [user_id] [limit] - show recent spam-filter actions.
/spamstatus [user_id] - show spam-filter counters.
/chatid - show current chat ID.
/topicid - show current topic ID.

job_sent: 💼 Job application sent to the owner. Laya put it on the shiny pile.
laya_mood_2: Mood: watching the chat and drawing conclusions. Poor ones.
laya_mood_3: Mood: sarcasm charged, patience at minimum.
laya_mood_4: Mood: cold. The chat temperature did not help.
laya_mood_5: Mood: irritation politely knocking on the radiator.
laya_mood_6: Mood: tired of all of you, but the protocol is still holding.
laya_mood_7: Mood: almost kind. Do not provoke the experiment.
laya_mood_8: Mood: like someone who understood everything and got tired.
laya_reaction_appeal_1: Appeal sent to the owner. Do not overfeed hope.
laya_reaction_appeal_2: Appeal accepted. The adults will look at it.
laya_reaction_appeal_3: Appeal delivered. Keep the drama in drafts.
laya_reaction_brother_insult_1: I saw that. Keep going, preferably smarter.
laya_reaction_brother_insult_2: Careful. That line had no useful payload.
laya_reaction_creator_insult_1: I saw that. The bravery is decorative.
laya_reaction_dumb_question_1: Question accepted. Intellectual value still missing.
laya_reaction_dumb_question_2: I will answer when the question catches up with the thought.
laya_reaction_dumb_question_3: The question arrived before the thought did. Tragic, but fixable.
laya_reaction_father_insult_1: I saw that. Try making the next line useful.
laya_reaction_father_insult_3: Noted. The next thought can still recover.
laya_reaction_idea_1: Idea sent to the general director. If it survives, we will know.
laya_reaction_idea_2: Idea recorded. I do not promise it will survive contact with reality.
laya_reaction_idea_3: Idea sent upward. It has an adult life now.
laya_reaction_mother_insult_1: I saw that. Find a better target for the noise.
laya_reaction_mother_insult_2: I heard that, and no, it was not clever.
laya_reaction_rehab_1: The psychiatric center is running. Please stop distracting the treatment from pretending it helps.
laya_reaction_rehab_2: The psych center is listening. Sadly, so am I.
laya_reaction_spam_1: I see spam. I no longer see patience.
laya_reaction_spam_3: Repeating yourself is a bold application for treatment.
